caption: An oval bread basket with a shallow cavity, low walls and two side grips.

An oval bread basket with a shallow cavity, low walls and two side grips. Continuous woven walls enclose a cavity; both arched handle ends join the rim. Oval walls keep an even thickness and the handle arch stays continuous. Overall width is 1.45 times depth; height is 0.32 times width. Parts follow functional positions.
A square storage basket with a closed base, four flat walls and two squared handles. Four flat walls enclose a cavity; two straight handles join opposite walls.
